name: HaloDomeHouse_08
note: HouseA (24 x 22 x 26). Square body 19 x 17 with four corner towers + finials, two storeys (door + two arched windows below; a shorter upper tier), double arched door with lantern pedestals, two big front urn pots, round drum with 3 arched windows and a ribbed gold dome. Missing: small gold dome canopy over the door, balcony balustrades with flower boxes on the upper tier, topiary cones beside the pots, wide front stairs (see generator_gaps.md). Upper-tier front has no window because the 2D shows a balcony there. Built from art/review/img3/HaloDomeHouse_08_check.jpg (2D panel); the 2D PNG and side view are not in the worktree.
